sign_convention: Positive pitcher_net / pitch_net = pitcher help. Labels follow the physics number's sign.

questions.question: Does tonight's air help or hurt THIS pitch, for THIS pitcher, right now?
questions.uses: First-pitch rho, P, rain, gusts, wind x this pitch velo/rpm/active spin x this pitcher's live air baseline (schedule + acclimation) + body clock

questions.question: Does that mix add up for the starter?
questions.uses: Usage-weighted mean of those pitch scores (break + speed + command + pickup)

questions.question: If a fly ball is hit, how far does it go?
questions.uses: Same park air vs ISA 20 C sea-level (400-ft reference)
questions.notes: Does not apply if there are no hits. Not a pitcher score. Home side != home air.

chosen_scales.not: fitted intercept / ridge / sample mean / z-score
chosen_scales.note: Projected total is constructed from THIS game. These numbers are chosen conversion scales (same class as tanh 1.6 / rain 0.55), not a fit to last week's 9.11 mean. No intercept. No z-clip. A tornado or Coors night is allowed to print 18-22. A rain-dead night can print 4-5.

formulas.name: Saturation vapor pressure (August-Roche-Magnus)
formulas.notes: T in Celsius. Open-Meteo hour nearest first pitch.

formulas.name: Moist density (ideal-gas mixture)
formulas.notes: This rho multiplies drag and Magnus. It is not elevation. Two parks at the same elevation on different nights are not the same air. Enclosed/roof-closed: external wind, gusts, rain = 0.

formulas.name: Arsenal window blend
formulas.expression: metric = 0.65 * last_30_days + 0.35 * season   (whichever window exists if only one)

formulas.name: Active spin source
formulas.expression: player-page spinAxis this season, else that pitcher's latest published season on the same page
formulas.notes: Savant Active Spin leaderboard is forbidden. Unpublished spin is unlabeled — never invented as 65%. Gyro sliders are supposed to be low.

formulas.name: Magnus proportional to rho (Stage 1 CSV vs ISA)
formulas.notes: Stage 1 CSV is lab-relative. Dashboard scores are restamped in Stage 2 vs live rho_ref.

formulas.name: Plate speed 1-D drag ODE
formulas.expression: v_plate(rho) = v_release / (1 + k * rho * L * v_release)

formulas.name: Crosswind location drift
formulas.expression: t = L / v_avg; a_cross = k * rho * v_avg * v_cross; drift = 0.5 * a_cross * t^2
formulas.notes: F_lat proportional to rho * v_pitch * v_cross.

formulas.name: Wind Magnus scale (pitch headwind / tailwind)
formulas.notes: Out-to-CF is a pitch headwind.

formulas.name: IF-hit density carry
formulas.notes: Not a pitcher score. If there are no hits this is zero in the game that actually happened.

formulas.name: IF-hit net carry
formulas.expression: delta_d_net = delta_d_density + delta_d_wind   [+ small enclosed-branch term]

formulas.name: Recent occupancy-weighted moist density
formulas.expression: rho_recent = occupancy-weighted true moist density of last 7 days; weight(d) = exp(-d / 3)
formulas.notes: rho_recent is Open-Meteo first-pitch air, not ISA-at-elevation.

formulas.name: Home-air memory
formulas.notes: days_since_home uses a 10-day window. Home SIDE != home AIR. A club can be the home side with w_home ~ 0.24 after a long road trip.

formulas.name: Live pitcher air baseline
formulas.notes: Same rho_game for both starters. Different rho_ref.

formulas.name: Timezone shift on current streak
formulas.expression: tz_shift = UTC_offset(tonight) - UTC_offset(origin of this TZ streak)
formulas.notes: Tracked against the current timezone streak, not last night's park.

formulas.name: Unrecovered body-clock hours
formulas.expression: rec_per_hour = 1.5 if eastward else 0.75; unrecovered_h = max(0, hours_jumped - elapsed/rec_per_hour)

formulas.name: Command from circadian
formulas.notes: THIS pitcher's play/ability.

formulas.name: Opposing-lineup pickup (pitcher benefit if they cannot pick it up)
formulas.notes: Other club's 16-day east-west path and body-clock hour, coupled to this pitch. Not this pitcher's air.

formulas.name: Signed vertical-break delta
formulas.expression: dz_signed = +delta_pfx_z_vs_ref if rise pitch (4-seam, cutter) else -delta_pfx_z_vs_ref
formulas.notes: More of the intended vertical break is pitcher help.

formulas.name: Break component
formulas.expression: break = tanh((dz_signed * spin_frac * velo_frac * rpm_frac) / 1.6) * 2.8 - rain_mm * spin_frac * rpm_frac * velo_frac * 0.55
formulas.notes: tanh compressors are display-class; they preserve sign.

formulas.name: Speed component
formulas.expression: speed = tanh(delta_v_plate_vs_ref / 1.8) * 1.1 - circadian_load * 0.08 * velo_frac - rain_mm * 0.08 * velo_frac

formulas.name: Command component
formulas.expression: command = -abs(wind_drift_x) * 0.8 * hang - abs(delta_pfx_x) * 0.08 + circ_cmd + command_region + command_road + rain_cmd + gust_cmd

formulas.name: Per-pitch net environmental impact (DISPLAY)
formulas.notes: Positive = pitcher help. No 0.1 dead-zone. Pitch Out excluded from the mix. Carry is NOT in this number.

formulas.name: Unclamped mix (RUN PROJECTION)
formulas.notes: Not the +/-8 display clamp. Tornado command can exceed -8.

formulas.name: Pitcher overall net env impact for that mix in that park
formulas.notes: Usage-weighted mean of DISPLAY-clamped pitch nets. INPUT to the card, not overwritten by the run projection.

formulas.name: This 9 vs this pitcher's hand
formulas.expression: lineup_RA9 = ((OPS_vs_this_hand - 0.720) / 0.080) * 0.55 + 0.40 * (0.5 - same_side_frac) - hide(4S_pct * velo/95, break_pct * same_side)
formulas.notes: CONFIRMED beats EXPECTED. Switch-hitters take the opposite hand. IL/Out in the top 5 taxes -0.22; DTD -0.08. Dropped from OPS mean if >=6 remain.

formulas.name: This team's remainder-IP RA9
formulas.expression: this_team_bullpen_RA9 = IP-weighted RP ERA + 0.22*RP_on_IL (cap 0.90) + 0.35 if closer IL + fatigue
formulas.notes: RP filter: GS/G < 0.4, or GS <= 3 and G >= 4; tonight's starter excluded; IP >= 3. Fatigue: yday RP IP >= 3.5 -> +0.35; 3d >= 7 -> +0.30; closer pitched yesterday -> +0.18. Unpublished bullpen -> 4.50 flagged bullpen_ra9_no_identity (unknown identity, not last week's 9.11 mean). Starter IL/Out clips IP_start to 3.0; DTD clips to 4.2.

formulas.name: Catcher framing RA9
formulas.notes: Positive Savant rv_tot = extra strikes = pitcher help = negative RA9. Full weight on starter RA9; 1/2 on remainder IP. No sample -> 0, labeled no framing sample, not invented. URL: baseballsavant.mlb.com/leaderboard/catcher-framing?year=YYYY&min=1&csv=true

formulas.name: HP umpire overlay
formulas.notes: Zone overlay — does not replace the physics total. Covers crew table + per-matchup card. If HP is not posted and this is series G2+, yesterday's 1B is today's HP (next HP-day in the same crew table).

formulas.name: IF-hit carry converted to RA9
formulas.notes: IF-hit only. Mix does not add fly-ball feet.

formulas.name: Starter runs allowed
formulas.notes: IP_start from IP/GS clipped 4-7; IL/Out min 3.0; DTD min 4.2; default 5.4.

formulas.name: Tonight's constructed game total
formulas.notes: Every run rebuilds this from this game. No 9.11 intercept. No z-score. Allowed to print 18-22 or 4-5.

formulas.name: Physics delta vs arms-only
formulas.notes: |delta| >= 1 -> PHYSICS_UP / PHYSICS_DOWN.

formulas.name: Market edge (display only)
formulas.notes: DraftKings / ScoresAndOdds / Covers location and series # are ingested and displayed. They do not calibrate the physics number. Do not stamp OVER/UNDER lean %.

formulas.name: Rain contact RA9 on remainder IP
formulas.notes: Harder to square up in rain.

rules: Daily collect is the calendar date of the run (America/New_York). Dated leftover folders are receipts.
Spin = player-page spinAxis only. Never invent spin. Never use the Savant Active Spin leaderboard.
Scores must not be empirically fitted to one historical slate. Labels follow the physics number's sign.
Carry is IF-the-ball-is-hit only. Do not use 'home vs visitor at Coors.'
Always populate a confirmed or expected nine. CONFIRMED beats EXPECTED.
Do not stamp per-game OVER/UNDER lean %. Market line is displayed, not a calibrator.
No 9.11 sample-mean intercept. No z-score toward last week. Projections can print 18-22 or 4-5.
V80/V84 remain on disk for forensics. Live product is V90.

limitations.status: Lab-relative. Dashboard scores use live rho_ref. Do not audit pitcher meaning from Stage 1 CSV alone.
External. n/a. Not used in env scores.
Retractable nights can still take the wrong branch if sources disagree.
Baseline break includes parks they actually threw in. Direction is tonight vs live rho_ref.
Pitch-headwind ride can score green while the same wind is IF-hit carry. Mix does not add fly-ball feet.
Not ODE-derived. Sign and ordering are the claim.

closing: V90 — the pitcher number is this mix in this first-pitch air. Carry is not that number. The projected total is these arms plus that physics, this 9, this C, this HP, and this pen, for this game.
